x: Of our others to compete, Snell was unlucky to be a few seconds outside second-class standard, and Chandler should have gained valuable experience.

Elson, Harley, Dodkin, Snell, Chandler, Dodkin, Boddington, Willis, Speechley, Holman, Rathbone, and others are training and from these men it should be possible to find eight to retain the "Nijmegen" Shield, and four to regain the National Championship.
Bicourt (2nd) Hudson(5th) Clarke (6th) Chandler (8th) and Freeman (9th) were involved in a close tussle in the boys' match, but were beaten 25/30 by Mitcham.
